review.summary: accept_with_corrections. Scope: separable.rs, an append-only test addition (433+/0-), ks_n7/ and results/KS_N7_IMPLEMENTATION.json. No protected path is touched, and the commits run notes, then code, then logs. Re-running make_results.py gives a byte-identical JSON. A rebuild of f53087a0 reproduces all 28 tagged log lines bit for bit, and fmt, clippy and verify_run pass. The Complex solve, the sphere kernel and the client are textually unchanged, and the default route gives the Complex bits. I checked the pairing algebra: the DC/Nyquist projection, odd nx and the lone row. On 18 grids the builder did not test, PairedReal matches Complex in 1776 cases (max normalized 3.3e-15) and dense elimination in 1040 cases (1.1e-15). Those grids include multi-batch grids with a lone last row, 4097x3, 2x5001, 256x256 and 128x128x64. Prepared reuse is bitwise and the routes take the same attempts. Major: the CI check RUSTDOCFLAGS=-D warnings fails on a doc link to the unexported BoxTransform; the planned re-export fixes it (verified). The timing check was not run (diagnostic: instructions 0.385).

findings.claim: At f53087a0 the CI docs check fails. RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo doc -p vigilode (job docs in .github/workflows/production.yml) stops on the lint rustdoc::private_intra_doc_links: 'public documentation for `with_box_transform` links to private item `BoxTransform::Complex`' (separable.rs:198). BoxTransform is not re-exported. The builder did not run this check.
findings.evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-cosmosapjw-vigilode/d057eb25-bf20-49ac-a1df-6dd2adc8a0a4/scratchpad/review_KS-N7/out/doc.log exits 101. With BoxTransform added to `pub use separable::{...}` in spatial.rs (scratch copy only), the same command exits 0 (out/doc_with_reexport.log).
findings.correction: At merge, add BoxTransform to the re-export in crates/vigilode/src/spatial.rs (the builder's open issue; it also makes the type nameable). Alternatively, inside KS-N7's path, drop the brackets of that doc link. Add the rustdoc -D warnings command to the node's checks.

findings.claim: Test gap. None of the builder's asserting box grids (16 grids plus 12x10, 4x6x5 and 7x5x3) has more than one packing batch, nx > 4096 or a lone odd row in a later batch. Those PairedReal paths ran only in the 256x256 and 128x128x64 smoke runs, which assert nothing.
findings.evidence: Every builder grid has one batch: min(max(4096/nx,1), ceil(rows/2)) >= ceil(rows/2). The reviewer tests on 100x97, 101x83, 4097x3, 2x5001, 3x4099, 30x31x33, 13x29x31, 64x3x63, 256x256 and 128x128x64 pass: max normalized 3.3e-15, T1 1.0e-14, 40 bitwise checks of prepared reuse, and a solve on another thread.
findings.correction: Add one multi-batch grid with an odd row count (100x97 or 30x31x33) and 4097x3 to ks_n7_box_grids.

findings.claim: Pre-existing, not a KS-N7 regression. The T2 check sums the mass naively from left to right, so it does not scale with grid size. On constant right-hand sides of grids with about 8e3 or more cells at large z it exceeds 1e-13 (3.35e-12 at 128x128x64), with identical values for Complex and PairedReal.
findings.evidence: In out/ks_n7_review_test.log (first run), 10 DC cases fail the naive T2 check. In out/ks_n7_review_t2.log, the same 10 cases give identical values for Complex. A compensated (Neumaier) mass gives <= 4.994e-16 for both arms, with no case above the bound in 1776.
findings.correction: None for KS-N7. If T2 gates large grids, use compensated summation.

findings.claim: The timing check is underspecified. 'Box stage solve time' can mean the new prepared stage_solver (the default scope) or solve_stage, which builds the plans on every call. The diagnostic ratios also include the x-mode-major layout and the removed integer division per element, so they do not isolate the pairing; the builder discloses this.
findings.evidence: The reviewer's perf run reproduces the builder's: 0.385 instructions, 0.21 cycles. The analytic FFT-line ratio is 0.502.
findings.correction: The orchestrator should preregister the scope (prepared, as in the driver) and report the FFT-line ratio separately from the time ratio.

findings.claim: The solution does not record the transform. A PairedReal run reports client id vigilode-separable-fourier-stages-v1, the same as Complex, and SeparableReport has no transform field, so the two arms cannot be told apart in Solution stats or labels.
findings.correction: Record the transform in SeparableReport or in the client id before any change of the default.

findings.claim: Two reporting nits. 'About half the buffer memory': at 256x256 PairedReal allocates 33,024 + 4,096 batch-line values against 65,536, a ratio of 0.57. 'Route diff <= 1.3e-15': the logged maximum is 1.332e-15.

Two process notes. First, tests/spatial_separable.rs is not in the PLAN.json KS-N7 file list; the edit is append-only (433+/0-) and is the test target PLAN names. Second, neither the builder nor the reviewer ran the full facade suite (--no-fail-fast) that CODING_AGENT_KO.txt lists.
findings.evidence: git diff --stat 05b5e3e3 f53087a0. Only spatial_separable.rs uses the separable API, and clippy --all-targets compiles every target.
findings.correction: The orchestrator should confirm that the test file was allowed, and run the facade suite at merge if it is required.
